LESSON: CHILD CUSTODY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Child custody

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Child custody. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Child custody
2. Practise Child custody at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Child custody

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Child custody
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Child custody. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Child custody at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Child custody at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Child custody
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Child custody. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Child custody using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Child custody in the examples.
2. Explain Child custody to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Child custody.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Child custody using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Child custody important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Child custody
2. Practise Child custody at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Child custody

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
